Definition: Sur, a gate of the temple
BiblicalUsage: Sur is a gate of the temple, named once in the ordering of the guards who protect the young king Joash. A third part of the guard keeps the gate of Sur, and the gate is part of the plan that keeps a king alive. The name is a door, and the door is a defence.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gate of Sur shows that God protects His anointed with ordinary doors and ordinary guards.
